title: POLITICSBENCH: BENCHMARKING POLITICAL VALUES IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS WITH MULTI-TURN ROLEPLAY

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses through 20 four-stage, multi-turn roleplay scenarios with escalating pressure. A judge model scores the in-character responses and out-of-character reflections on a scale of ten distinct political values (e.g., egalitarianism, authority deference) to calculate an overall left-right alignment score.
